Instant Hot Chocolate
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 11:21pm

Ingredients




8 cups Powdered milk
2 1/2 cups chocolate drink mix * see note
3/4 cup Powdered non-dairy creamer
1 cup Sifted powdered sugar

Preparation

1 *Use the powdered instant chocolate drink mix. Mix all ingredients in a large container. To serve, add 1/4 cup of mixture to 1 cup boiling water; top with marshmallows.
